title: Loi modifiant la Loi sur le stockage de gaz naturel et sur les conduites de gaz naturel et de pétrole aux fins d'autoriser la mise en œuvre d'un projet pilote relatif à la recherche ou à l'exploitation d'un réservoir souterrain ou de certains fluides (titre modifié)
titleEn: Act to amend the Act respecting the storage of natural gas and respecting natural gas and oil pipelines in order to authorize the implementation of a pilot project respecting the exploration or development of an underground reservoir or certain fluids (title amended)
noteEn:
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas and respecting natural gas and oil pipelines: a person must hold a licence to explore or develop an underground reservoir or certain fluids.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: the conditions for obtaining and keeping a licence will be set by a rule of the Québec Cabinet, without a new vote at the National Assembly.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: the Québec Cabinet will be able to set rules on work, on authorizations required from the Minister of Economy, Innovation and Energy, and on the closing or restoration of sites.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: certain reservoirs or fluids belonging to the State will be reserved for the State or off-limits to any exploration, notably in urban areas or protected areas.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: the Minister will be able to temporarily suspend the granting of a licence on a piece of land while deciding whether to reserve or exclude it.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: a licence holder and a holder of mining rights on the same land will have to agree on how they carry out their activities, following rules to be set later.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: the Minister will have to monitor sites where carbon storage has taken place.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: documents and information sent to the Minister by a licence holder will be public, except for exceptions set by a rule of the Québec Cabinet.
- Act respecting the storage of natural gas: authorizations to build and use pipelines will now apply only to oil pipelines, not natural gas pipelines.
- Act respecting land use planning and development: a mechanism will allow work conditions to be included in municipal bylaws.
- Act respecting land use planning and development: a municipality will be able, in certain cases set out by a rule of the Québec Cabinet, to block work from being carried out on its territory.
- Act to end petroleum and underground reservoir exploration, petroleum production and brine exploitation: the new framework does not allow what this Act already bans.
- Mining Act, Natural Heritage Conservation Act, Act respecting municipal taxation, Act respecting the Department of Natural Resources and Wildlife, Parks Act, Act respecting the lands in the domain of the State and other texts: concordance adjustments related to the new rules on underground reservoirs.
